kaze_water_quad_subdivide_render.note: Tier 3 (2026-07-10): island #1 is a sanctioned GTE cfc2 bundle. Island #2 is a scheduling island, not an unaligned-access requirement: lwl/lwr is achievable in C (a CopyBlk struct copy, __builtin_memcpy, or a packed struct all emit the exact bytes, confirmed in isolation). It enforces a copy-at-head plus argument-move-in-delay-slot order that C alone could not reach, because a store cannot be hoisted past the following external call: removing it regresses the differing-word count from 17 to 35. The lawful floor using only the cfc2 bundle is 17 words / 1200 bytes. A follow-up probe confirmed island #2 is essential: without it, the naive form produces 289 instructions, the wrong instruction count and size, since the barrier is what prevents an incorrect anti-dependency hoist. Island #1's cfc2 access remains GTE-sanctionable.
